snippet.title: Deadline - MS-DOS
snippet.description:
The 1996 PC game Deadline, nobody had uploaded it yet so I thought I would :-)   The only Deadline game videos were of the 1982 infocom text adventure.  Running in DOSBox 0.74, according to the box, it's also compatible with Windows 95/98

This is the 2nd time I "played" it.  At the start of the mission I accidentaly moved one of the way points because I forgot how to go to the "live action", and the last 2 minutes of this video is me failing to get them to go upstairs.  The first time I played it however, I managed to get them to go upstairs and I pretty much secured everyone without ANY of my team members dying, but then didn't know what to do next so just quit XD
